title: Memory Fabric retraction event, protocol v1
description: A retraction issued by an origin store for one exact memory version. Specification only; no implementation exists as of commit 597bdcb. See docs/PROTOCOL.md and docs/AUDIT.md.

retraction_id.description: Stable across retries. With origin_store_id, this is the deduplication key.

origin_store_id.description: Stable opaque id, never a filesystem path, hostname or port.

origin_memory_id.description: Local to the origin store. Only meaningful paired with origin_store_id.

origin_memory_version.description: The exact version retracted. A retraction never applies to a greater version.

origin_sequence.description: Per-origin monotonic counter. Not a global clock and not comparable across origins.

reason_code.description: Drawn from memory_fabric.model.WithdrawalBasis. co_occurrence and unstated are measured-weak: see research/results/phase-a-prime-attribution.md.

evidence_digest.description: Hash of the evidence, not the evidence. Memory content may contain exactly what governance exists to keep out of secondary surfaces.

evidence_reference.description: Dereferenceable by a recipient that is authorised to follow it. May be refused.

issued_at.description: Advisory only. Never decides precedence: clocks disagree and a sender controls its own.

signature.description: Proves origin and integrity. Proves nothing about whether the retracted claim was false.
